title: Hardship Settlement Extension Allowance for Posted Consumer Payments
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Payment-Record Allowance

Consumer payments posted in the money history of the Placed Consumer Accounts record count toward the payment record that bears on a due-date extension of an accepted Hardship Settlement under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements.

**Rule.** Every consumer payment posted to the account counts toward the Hardship Settlement payment record, a payment that was later returned included; where three or more have been posted, the payment-record allowance of 2 days is added; where one or two have been posted, the payment-record allowance is 1 day; an account with no posted consumer payment earns no payment-record allowance.

| Consumer payments posted to the account (returned ones included) | Payment-record allowance |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2 days |
| 1 or 2 | 1 day |
| none | none |

## Hypothetical cases

1. Four payments posted over the life of the account: 2 days.
2. One payment posted and later returned: it still counts, so 1 day.
3. No consumer payment ever posted: no allowance.
